question_text: The Department of Health (DOH) establishes a regional office in Cebu to oversee health programs in the Visayas. Meanwhile, the Province of Cebu passes an ordinance creating a provincial health board. Which of the following best distinguishes these two forms of decentralization?

options.text: The DOH regional office is an example of devolution, while the provincial health board is an example of deconcentration.
The DOH regional office is an example of deconcentration, while the provincial health board is an example of devolution.
Both are examples of devolution because they involve local governments.
Both are examples of deconcentration because they are under the national government.
